description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment: Wataddara, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510617
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries addressing specific land parcels, including expunging names from ownership records, amending land extent measurements, and inserting servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, cadastral maps, and title corrections, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
